title: Watch, build and explain

referenceVideo.title: Learn SwiftUI online for FREE | Bootcamp #0

scope: These links were matched using Swiftful Thinking's public catalogue, its explanation of progressive learning, and searchable YouTube titles/descriptions. Your reference is the SwiftUI Bootcamp introduction. Videos and transcripts were not watched or copied, and paid lessons were not accessed. Topic links support the named concepts; playlists support a whole stage rather than an exact episode for every lesson. Our practice routine, examples and projects are original.

sources.title: Progressive learning explained by the creator
Bootcamp topics followed by app practice

routine.title: See one small result
routine.instruction: Name the behavior you want before opening the editor. A caption, a button or one saved item is enough for the first attempt.

routine.title: Watch one concept
routine.instruction: Use the matching topic link or stage playlist. Watch a short section, pause, and say what you think the next code change will do.

routine.title: Follow, then predict
routine.instruction: Work through our small example one step at a time. Explain each name and symbol. Compare your prediction with the actual output or visible state.

routine.title: Make your own change
routine.instruction: Close the worked answer and change an input or requirement yourself. Reuse the rule you just learned before adding a new concept.

routine.title: Check the result
routine.instruction: Use the lesson's acceptance points. Keep an actual run, test or observation, including a failing case and the reason for your repair.

routine.title: Explain it in your words
routine.instruction: Describe the Swift rule first, then compare it with Kotlin or Java. Answer the quiz and interview prompt, and save the next question in your notes.

stages.focus: Start with a tiny Swift program. Learn one rule about values, choices or types, then use it in the next example.
